profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Thermo Fisher Scientific | Electron Microscopy
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience, I specialize in developing cutting-edge software solutions for semiconductor failure analysis systems at Thermo Fisher Scientific. My work focuses on instrument control, hardware integration, and automation systems leveraging technologies like C#/.NET to create reliable tools for defect detection and advanced scientific applications.  

My expertise in electron microscopy, Agile methodologies, and cross-functional collaboration has allowed me to contribute to the development of next-generation scanning electron microscope (SEM) platforms. I am motivated by solving complex engineering challenges where software and hardware intersect, enabling engineers and researchers to drive innovation in high-precision laboratory environments.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop software for next-generation semiconductor failure analysis systems using scanning electron microscopes (SEM)
• Design and implement instrument-control software using C#/.NET
• Integrate complex laboratory hardware including microscopy and measurement systems
• Debug and enhance software used for micrometer-scale defect detection
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum development environments
